title: Secundum quid perfections in God only virtute & eminenter
source_text: XI. His ita notatis dicimus perfectiones illas creaturarum quas vocavimus secundum quid, in Deo quidem non esse proprie & formaliter: attamen Deum omnes illas habere virtute & eminenter.
pass_a_gloss: These things thus noted, we say that those perfections of creatures which we called secundum quid are indeed not properly and formally in God: yet that God has all of them by virtue and eminently.
pass_b_english: Secundum quid creature-perfections: not formal in God.
Yet God has them all by virtue and eminently.

lemmas.gloss: not to be properly and formally

choices.term: Deum omnes illas habere virtute & eminenter
choices.english: that God has all of them by virtue and eminently
choices.why: Applies taxonomy to secundum quid set.
rejected: secundum quid perfections are formal in God
